mapper.select: SELECT id, generation_job_id, user_id, reserved_credits, actual_credits, receivable_credits, status, allocations, catalog_version, discount_bp, rule_snapshot, title, release_note, gmt_create, gmt_modified, version FROM billing_cost_reservations WHERE generation_job_id = #{jobId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_cost_reservations SET status = 'settled', actual_credits = #{actualCredits}, receivable_credits = #{receivableCredits}, version = version + 1 WHERE generation_job_id = #{jobId}
UPDATE billing_cost_reservations SET status = 'released', actual_credits = 0, release_note = #{releaseNote}, version = version + 1 WHERE generation_job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, COALESCE(SUM(actual_credits), 0) AS amount FROM billing_cost_reservations WHERE user_id IN #{uid} AND status = 'settled' GROUP BY user_id

SELECT id, generation_job_id, user_id, reserved_credits, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, gmt_modified, NOW()) AS held_seconds FROM billing_cost_reservations WHERE status = 'held' AND gmt_modified <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND) ORDER BY gmt_modified ASC LIMIT #{limit}
